scope: Data-driven combat and special ability pure-rule tests. Actual geometry, animation, live input, and rendering are browser integration responsibilities.

results.name: All 5 weapon IDs match v3 magazine and save capacities
Every numeric gameplay key has explicit proposed-value provenance
Applying authoring data preserves labels, reserves, recoil and input mode
Unknown weapon definitions are not rewritten
Damage stays full before and at falloff start
Damage interpolates between start and end and clamps afterward
Head and ability multiplier each apply exactly once
Shotgun deals 9 per pellet and 72 maximum body damage per shell
Invalid distance and outgoing multiplier cannot heal or generate NaN damage
Recovery waits for damage delay and never restores armor
Recovery crossing delay heals only eligible fraction of tick
Recovery caps at 50 without lowering healthy players
Recovery cannot revive dead actors or advance on pause
Invalid recovery inputs fail before health mutation
Focus activates on foot and enables qualitative slowdown only while active
Driver ability requires a live driver, not a passenger or pedestrian
On-foot abilities reject vehicle and transition states
Assault changes damage factors without time slowdown
Energy drains in active-real time even when world advances slowly
Wheel slowdown does not multiply energy lifetime
Eight active-real seconds deplete energy and stop the effect
Energy regenerates only after cooldown, then caps at maximum
Activation minimum and cooldown are enforced
Zero active delta cannot drain energy or cool down a paused ability
Death immediately cancels ability and does not refill dead actor
Getting into vehicle, leaving driver seat, and transitions cancel active effects
Role selection is not a free energy refill or cooldown reset
Role aliases are normalized and invalid IDs are rejected
Save round-trip preserves energy and prevents automatic activation on load
Malformed ability snapshots are rejected atomically
Large and partitioned real-time updates have equivalent drain/cooldown/regen
